June 29, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Wealth Architects Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 22.63% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wealth Architects Llc bought 7,465 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 40,453 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.79 million, up from 32,988 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wealth Architects Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $916.38 billion market cap company.
